name: MegaFon (PJSC)
note: Russian mobile operator whose shares are no longer publicly traded. Last named-press attribution: as of early 2023, The Moscow Times (30 Jan 2023) and RBC (21 Feb 2023) reported MegaFon 100% owned by Alisher Usmanov's USM Group (claim megafon-usm-ownership). Its 2024 annual report (corp.megafon.ru) names two equal shareholders — OOO «АФ Телеком Холдинг» (50%) and OOO «ЮэСэМ Телеком» (50%) — and says the state does not participate in the charter capital. Its 2025 IFRS statements (audited 5 Mar 2026) withhold those names, stating only that both companies' common ultimate controlling entity is itself owned by a group of participants no one of whom can control it alone (disclosure restricted by Russia's 2023 sensitive-information rules). The current ultimate owner is therefore not publicly identified.
